stories.title: Cabby killed, 9 others injured after taxi hits bus, truck on Lantau Island
stories.summary: A cab driver was killed and at least nine other people were injured after his taxi collided with a bus and a truck on Hong Kong’s Lantau Island on Tuesday night. Police said at around 8pm that they had received reports of a crash on Cheung Tung Road involving a taxi, a truck and a DB03P bus heading from Discovery Bay to Sunny Bay MTR station. The taxi driver was knocked unconscious and became trapped in the wreckage of his vehicle, while his passenger was seriously injured but remained...
